period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis (the 'Condensed Balance Sheet'/'Condensed Profit & Loss Account' columns headed 'Eastern Bank PLC.', as distinct from the 'Eastern Bank PLC. and its subsidiaries' Consolidated columns). Per project-wide convention, this Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing is the Q2 data point. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (column header '01 January 2025 to 30 June 2025'), flagged via the _cumulative suffix. This filing also discloses a discrete 'April-June' column (not used for line_items, kept only for context): discrete Q2-only PAT was 2,059,659,030, and Q1 2025 PAT (1,805,234,242, per 2025_Q1.json) plus this equals 3,864,893,272, matching this filing's own H1 cumulative PAT exactly. RESTATEMENT FOUND: this contemporaneous filing reports EPS (restated) = 2.42 for H1 2025. The later 2026_Q2.json (Half-Yearly 2026) filing's comparative column instead shows EPS = 2.35 for the same H1 2025 period, with an IDENTICAL PBT/PAT (6,059,390,965 / 3,864,893,272 in both filings). This traces to a further bonus share issue between this filing (1,595,813,388 shares outstanding as of 30 June 2025) and the 2026 filing (1,643,687,789 shares by 30 June 2026) — IAS 33 retroactive EPS restatement, not an error. This filing's own Statement of Changes in Equity shows the FY2024 bonus share issue (paid-up capital 13,581,390,540 to 15,958,133,880, +2,376,743,340) plus a cash dividend payment occurred during Q2 2025 (Apr-Jun) — this is the corporate action that drove the 2025_Q1.json-to-2025_Q2.json EPS restatement noted in 2025_Q1.json, and the same AGM-timing seasonal pattern recurs in 2026 (see 2026_Q2.json). Cross-checked the 31 December 2024 comparative column against bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2024_Q4.json: total_assets, gross_loans, total_deposits, investments_securities, fixed_assets, borrowings, total_equity all match exactly (see 2025_Q1.json for the same comparative figures, identical here).
